name: Why Not Both?
source:
Why Not Both? is a kinetic visual novel set in an optimistic solarpunk future, blending emotional storytelling, romantic tension, and positive polyamorous representation. 

The story follows Rio, Jen, and Aspen during their sophomore year at Silver Sire, a thriving academic institution. Amid academic pursuits, emotional struggles, and evolving relationships, they must confront the complexities of identity, desire, and love. 

Why Not Both? invites readers into a world of discovery, connection, and courage to follow one's heart.

[From [url=https://studio-rally.itch.io/why-not-both]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《何不兩個都選？》是一部以樂觀的太陽龐克未來為舞臺的單線視覺小說，將細膩的情感敘事、戀人之間的張力，以及對多元之愛的正面描繪融在一起。

故事講述里奧、珍和阿斯彭在欣欣向榮的銀爵學府度過的二年級。面對學業上的追求、情感上的掙扎，以及不斷變化的關係，他們必須正視身分、慾望與愛之間的複雜糾葛。

《何不兩個都選？》邀請讀者走進他們的世界，一同探索、與人產生聯結，鼓起勇氣聽從自己的心。

［摘自[url=https://studio-rally.itch.io/why-not-both]itch.io[/url]］
